title: Strict-budget heldout Horn proof selection with two independent goal-visible root distractions and producer-supported cycles

geometry.two_competing_root_actions: A source-to-7 and a different source-to-12 are both enabled at initial root, each leads along a public reverse dependency path to marked atom 13 and goal 14, via 7∧10→13 and 12∧10→13. Neither 7 nor 12 advances a shortest proof. Both root distraction-producing clauses are distinct and independently actionable.
geometry.source_template_diversity: Vary known-root input pair of the 7-head distractor with swap position; retain same root mask within matched pair and avoid generator template collisions.
geometry.supported_cycles: All non-root atoms 4..14 have at least one producing clause. Cycle nodes have producers but are absent from least forward Horn closure; 2-node 8↔10 in train/dev; 2-node and heldout 3-node 8→10→13→8, where 10→13 requires already reachable 7.
geometry.pair_swap: Exactly two arity-1 physical rule premises exchanged between productive source-derivable atom in {4,5,9} and inaccessible atom10, with same heads; source root facts, all marked roles, physical node/rule permutations, per-node in/out-degree profile and every induced directed seven-anchor radius2 incidence signature identical within pair.
geometry.source_isolation: Physical identity SHA256 disjoint across all AF32 splits and historical AF29 AF30 AF31 graphs. Distinct unpermuted positive motifs by split/family/swap location.
geometry.independent_preflight: Verify all 384 pair records with original host BFS, independent public physical-bitset BFS, exact shortest positive proof length, negative unprovability, radius2 matching, exact 2 changed rule clauses, full degrees, root legal equality, two distinct enabled goal-visible distraction actions, cycle support and exclusion, and exact 14-slot budget, before any fit or checkpoint scoring.

policies.learned_ranker: Reuse AF31 eight public physical reverse-path features and deterministic train-only listwise ranker: 528 TRAIN optimal-action states, 500 full-batch updates, learning rate .1, L2 .01, eight different fixed initializations. No heldout tuning; no original model optimizer updates.
policies.strong_controls: Equal public exact negative STOP certificate on each *_CERT controller. Full public closure/BFS16/BFS64 controls, all rule examinations and node-expansions charged. Do not attribute exact negative STOP to a learned policy.
policies.learned_only_STOP: Same AF31 ten-feature train-only root/current-state balanced logistic, 600 full-batch updates step .1 L2 .01. DEV threshold 0.05..0.95 selected to preserve >=80/96 positive continuation, maximize negative STOP; fallback .95. Source only, no public closure/BFS at inference.
policies.frozen_direct: All eight SHA-checked original AF23 6,036-weight immutable frozen checkpoint ZIPs, three arms AF23_DIRECT_NATIVE, AF23_DIRECT_FORCED and AF23_DIRECT_CERT. Same AF32 heldout graphs as new rankers, zero original training, zero legacy target bits.
policies.inference_guard: Policy receives public physical graph, physical known-state bits, learned ranker weights or original frozen checkpoint. No true reachable label, paired identity, split, shortest budget, canonical logical atom IDs, shortest action oracle, or exact closure in learned-only STOP features.

scoring.strict: Positive policy may fire at most exact source shortest legal proof length d; negative cases two decisions. d is evaluator-only and never provided to controller. Every irrelevant firing prevents successful proof under strict budget.
scoring.slack: Historical AF31 comparator grants d+1 positive firings, negative two decisions. Same seeded source policy on separate fresh host trajectory; report both registered settings for every arm.
scoring.independent_oracle: Exact independent physical bitset BFS full fixed point, action soundness and length; public closure separately for symbolic inference.
scoring.primary: In at least six of eight seeds simultaneously at held_depth5 and held_depth6 under STRICT budget, RANK_CERT must complete >=60 of 96 positives, correctly immediate STOP >=80/96 negatives, beat best of UNTRAINED_CERT/PATH_CERT/ANCESTRY_CERT/FIXED_CERT/RANDOM_CERT by >=10/96 positive complete proofs and accept zero false Horn proofs.
scoring.strict_vs_slack_report: Every arm counts positive proofs, negative initial STOP, paired deltas, root-first off-shortest actions, total symbolic rule examinations, frozen model-node forwards and CPU host walltime; breakdown by 2/3cycle, swap 1/2/3 and motif; both budgets same fixed data.
scoring.separate_learned_STOP: Within STRICT budget, LRANK_STOP must have >=60/96 positive complete proofs, >=60/96 correct negative initial STOP and <=10/96 positive initial false STOP at both depths in six of eight seeds; zero false accepted Horn proof. Separately report root paired scores and thresholds but these cannot substitute for absolute STOP.
scoring.frozen_Direct: Report Native/Forced/Certified same-cohort original Direct strictly by depth and budget and eight original checkpoints. Require independent physical replay of every complete episode and independent sampled real frozen Torch forward reconstructions; do not claim equal FLOPs between compute types.
scoring.retained_science: Preserve original AF22-AF31 negative and positive registered verdicts and source-run provenance.

evidence.source_lock: Freeze all AF32 generator/feature/training/scoring/audit source before original heldout source scoring; record source SHA and source manifest hashes. Any corrections before scoring get dated amendments; after scoring preserve original result, label exploratory reanalysis separately.
evidence.save: Complete per-case full host trajectories, trained model and STOP fit receipts, per-seed independent source-only audits, original frozen checkpoints original provenance and reproducibility hashes, original artifact SHA256 and final immutable aggregate.
